ServiceId.description: Unique identifier of [Service](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/services/#service) the voucher belongs to.

EnterpriseId.description: Unique identifier of the enterprise to which the voucher belongs.

CreatedUtc.description: Creation date and time of the voucher in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

UpdatedUtc.description: Last update date and time of the voucher in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

Type.title: Voucher Type
Type.description:
Type of the voucher.

Public

PartnerCompany

TravelAgency

ActivityState.title: Activity state
ActivityState.description:
Whether voucher is active or deleted.

Deleted

Active

CompanyId.description: Unique identifier of [Company](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/companies/#company) the voucher is related to.

TravelAgencyId.description: Unique identifier of [Company](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/companies/#company) with [Travel agency contract](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/companycontracts/#travel-agency-contract) the voucher is related to.

OccupiableIntervalStartUtc.description: Start of the time interval, expressed as the timestamp for the start of the first time unit, in UTC timezone ISO 8601 format.

OccupiableIntervalEndUtc.description: End of the time interval, expressed as the timestamp for the start of the last time unit, in UTC timezone ISO 8601 format.

ExternalIdentifier.description: Identifier of the voucher from external system.

IsActive.description: Whether the voucher is still active.
